items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launches and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, affiliate, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Evidence: compliance is technical-only with 35 pass, 18 fail, and 6 unknown; security fleet-doctor and operations sweeps have no results; analytics quality is yellow; revenue is limited to 2026-09-21 aggregate Amazon evidence of 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 unattributed commission. Exact decision: maintain containment-only execution, authorize no new spend or monetization expansion, and admit no new queue work until existing repair containment clears.

SearchWoot remains blocked for public beta, full launch, alert expansion, affiliate use, and advertising. Woot documentation establishes API access but not rights to store, derive, cache, display, alert on, or monetize deal and price-history data; current public terms restrict the proposed use. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use. Keep the product private and preview-only; keep rights outreach unsent pending counsel review and owner authorization.

Continue only existing repair-or-close and deployed-work measurement. Do not requeue unchanged failures, add telemetry, deploy, add dependencies, expand monetization, or create duplicate requests. The existing saveusfarms.com repair-or-close case remains open through 2026-09-30T07:30Z and must record ownership, root cause or closure rationale, isolated validation, build checks, rollback, release/security boundary, attribution limits, measurement limits, and deduplication evidence.

Keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. No publish, deployment, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared. Next evidence action: attach a dated readiness packet for each property covering ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 remain open. Do not close tasks without direct evidence. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle covering field-level source rights, deployed data flow, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent and unsubscribe behavior, GA4 consent/configuration/retention, log fields, vendor coverage, incident/request procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence; then route rights and jurisdictional gaps to human counsel.
